scripts.dev: npm run build -w @relaydesk/contracts && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @relaydesk/api" "npm run dev -w @relaydesk/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @relaydesk/contracts && npm run build -w @relaydesk/api && npm run build -w @relaydesk/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @relaydesk/contracts && npm run test -w @relaydesk/api
